p: concerning the children of Israel: Because they might declare them to the Israelites.
peace at her: For in so doing he approves her.
father disallow her in the day: By not approving or consenting to her vow.
uttered ought out of her lips: Either by oath, or solemn promise.
soul: For she is in subjection to her husband, and can perform nothing without his consent.
against her: For they are not under the authority of the man.
afflict the soul: To mortify herself by abstinence or other bodily exercise.
day to day: And warn her not the same day that he hears it, as in Nu 30:8.
make them void after that he: Not the same day he heard them, but some day after, the sin will be imputed to him and not to her.
